mappingRationale.D1A: Supports recognition of clinical contexts that may lead to pediatric respiratory PSG evaluation.

authorityBoundary: Use this BRPT-listed 2011 practice parameter for pediatric respiratory PSG indication context only. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls scoring and technical definitions. Current AASM/ICSD guidance controls newer diagnostic terminology, and newer pediatric respiratory or treatment guidance controls where it supersedes this document.
copyrightUse: Use citation, public section-topic identity, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce recommendation wording, evidence tables, figures, or substantial passages.
